basic_details.short_information: Srirama Chandra Bhanja Medical College and Hospital (SCB Medical College Kataka) Walk-In-Interview 2026 for ICMR Project Contractual Posts! Published on 18-07-2026. This recruitment offers 04 contractual posts under the ICMR project at SCB Medical College, Kataka. Interested eligible candidates may appear for the Walk-in-Interview on 31.07.2026 at 10.30 AM. Find all details about eligibility, application form, and notification PDF here.

how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-I) from https://scbmch.odisha.gov.in/
Bring duly filled application + one set of self-attested photocopies + latest passport size photo.
Bring all original documents for verification.
Report between 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM on 31.07.2026 at College Council Hall, SCB Medical College, Kataka. Applications received after 11:30 AM will not be entertained.
